components: main-line stem, shallow leftward bowl, and final hook
strokeOrder: draw the independent stem downward and continue left through the shallow bowl and final hook without lifting
lift once, then draw the long slash down from the upper right toward the stem
lift again, then draw the shorter floating slash above the first

strokeOrderSource.citation: Persian Online, How to Write Persian Characters, گ demonstration at 02:24–02:28 (Liberal Arts Instructional Technology Services, Univ. of Texas at Austin)
strokeOrderSource.variation: The cited freehand lesson demonstrates isolated Persian گ in three pen-down runs. First the writer draws the independent stem downward and continues left through the shallow bowl and hooked finish; after one lift, the long slash descends from the upper right toward the stem; after another lift, the shorter floating slash is drawn above the first. This order fits the vendored Noto Naskh outline and retains Persian-scoped provenance rather than borrowing the independently verified Urdu گ source.

notes: Persian gāf adds a shorter floating slash above the long slash of kāf.
